senses.gloss:
Bhodūlāl
minister of Viśvanāthasiṃha; a. advaitin who figures in Sarvasiddhānta philosophy of his chief. He evidently disagreed with the Viśiṣṭādvaita of his chief. See L. 2329.

Bhodyuttorasūta
q. by Nāgārjuna in his Daśabhūmibhāṣāśāstra; title restored by R. Kimura. See IHQ. III. p. 417.
